```{ojs}
addLegendTopRight = (svg, items, {
  padding = 8,
  gap = 10,                // you can keep this small now
  swatch = 17,
  fontFamily = bodyFont,
  fontSize = 12,
  corner = 10,             // distance from top-right
  bg = "var(--plot-bg)",
  border = "var(--plot-grid)"
} = {}) => {
  const root = d3.select(svg);

  // Build legend; park it off-screen so it still participates in layout.
  const g = root.append("g")
    .attr("class", "plot-legend")
    .attr("font-family", fontFamily)
    .attr("font-size", fontSize)
    .attr("pointer-events", "none")
    .attr("transform", "translate(-1000000,-1000000)");

  const rowGap = 8;
  const rows = g.selectAll("g.row")
    .data(items)
    .join("g")
      .attr("class", "row")
      .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0, ${i * (fontSize + rowGap) + fontSize / 2})`);

  // swatch
  rows.append("line")
    .attr("x1", 0).attr("x2", swatch)
    .attr("y1", 0).attr("y2", 0)
    .attr("stroke", d => d.stroke)
    .attr("stroke-width", d => d.strokeWidth ?? 2)
    .attr("stroke-dasharray", d => d.dasharray ?? null)
    .attr("stroke-linecap", "butt");

  // label
  rows.append("text")
    .attr("x", swatch + gap)
    .attr("y", 0)
    .attr("dominant-baseline", "middle")
    .attr("fill", d => d.stroke)
    .attr("font-weight", "600")
    .text(d => d.label);

  const labels = rows.select("text");

  // Background (inserted now; sized after measurement)
  const bgRect = g.insert("rect", ":first-child")
    .attr("class", "legend-bg")
    .attr("rx", 8).attr("ry", 8)
    .attr("fill", bg)
    .attr("fill-opacity", 0.9)
    .attr("stroke", border);

  function place() {
    // 1) Ensure labels' *painted* left edge starts at swatch+gap
    let adjusted = false;
    labels.each(function () {
      const t = this;
      const b = t.getBBox();
      const desiredLeft = swatch + gap;   // in the row's coord system
      const overshoot = desiredLeft - b.x; // >0 means glyph extends left
      if (overshoot > 0.1) {
        const x = parseFloat(t.getAttribute("x")) || 0;
        t.setAttribute("x", x + overshoot);
        adjusted = true;
      }
    });

    // If we adjusted any label, schedule another frame so BBoxes settle
    if (adjusted) {
      requestAnimationFrame(place);
      return;
    }

    // 2) Size background to content
    const content = g.node().getBBox();
    if (!content || content.width === 0 || content.height === 0) {
      requestAnimationFrame(place);
      return;
    }

    const boxW = content.width + 2 * padding;
    const boxH = content.height + 2 * padding;

    bgRect
      .attr("x", content.x - padding)
      .attr("y", content.y - padding)
      .attr("width", boxW)
      .attr("height", boxH);

    // 3) Anchor to SVG viewBox top-right
    const vb = svg.viewBox?.baseVal;
    const vbx = vb?.x ?? 0;
    const vby = vb?.y ?? 0;
    const vbw = vb?.width
      ?? (+svg.getAttribute("width") || svg.getBBox().width || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width);

    const tx = Math.round(vbx + vbw - boxW - corner);
    const ty = Math.round(vby + corner);

    g.attr("transform", `translate(${tx}, ${ty})`);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(place);
};

```

```{ojs}
mutable biasRngSeed = 1
mutable varianceHistory = []
mutable biasResampleClicks = 0
mutable biasResetClicks = 0
mutable biasLastSamplesPerClick = 1
```

```{ojs}
// Edge-trigger the Reset
{
  if (biasReset > biasResetClicks) {
    mutable varianceHistory = [];
    mutable biasResetClicks = biasReset;
  }
  return html``;
}

// Reset biasResampleClicks when samplesPerClick changes
{
  if (biasControls.biasSamplesPerClick !== biasLastSamplesPerClick) {
    mutable biasLastSamplesPerClick = biasControls.biasSamplesPerClick;
    mutable biasResampleClicks = 0;
  }
  return html``;
}

// Edge-trigger the Resample: add current variance to history then generate new sample
{
  if (biasResample > biasResampleClicks) {
    // Add the current variance to history first
    mutable varianceHistory = [...varianceHistory, sampleVar];
    
    // If doing multiple samples, add the additional ones
    if (biasControls.biasSamplesPerClick > 1) {
      const additionalVariances = [];
      for (let i = 1; i < biasControls.biasSamplesPerClick; i++) {
        const rand = d3.randomNormal.source(d3.randomLcg(biasRngSeed + i))(biasControls.biasTrueMu, biasControls.biasTrueSigma);
        const sample = d3.range(biasControls.biasN).map(rand);
        const mean = d3.mean(sample);
        // Biased variance estimator (1/n)
        const variance = d3.sum(sample, d => (d - mean) ** 2) / biasControls.biasN;
        additionalVariances.push(variance);
      }
      mutable varianceHistory = [...varianceHistory, ...additionalVariances];
    }
    
    // Update seed for next sample (which will be displayed)
    mutable biasRngSeed = biasRngSeed + biasControls.biasSamplesPerClick;
    mutable biasResampleClicks = biasResample;
  }
  return html``;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Helper to make a styled button (reuse from above but with bias prefix)
function biasStyledButton(label, cls, options = {}) {
  const el = Inputs.button(label, options);
  const btn = el.querySelector('button');
  if (btn) btn.classList.add(cls);
  return el;
}

// Define themed buttons with updated label for multi-sample
viewof biasResample = biasStyledButton(
  biasControls.biasSamplesPerClick > 1 
    ? `Resample (×${biasControls.biasSamplesPerClick})` 
    : "Resample", 
  "btn-resample", 
  { reduce: c => (c ?? 0) + 1 }
);

viewof biasReset = biasStyledButton("Reset", "btn-reset", {
  reduce: c => (c ?? 0) + 1
});

// --- Current sample (always visible) ---
biasX = {
  const rand = d3.randomNormal.source(d3.randomLcg(biasRngSeed))(biasControls.biasTrueMu, biasControls.biasTrueSigma);
  return d3.range(biasControls.biasN).map(rand);
}
biasXbar = d3.mean(biasX)
// Biased variance estimator (1/n instead of 1/(n-1))
sampleVar = d3.sum(biasX, d => (d - biasXbar) ** 2) / biasControls.biasN
// Unbiased variance for comparison
unbiasedVar = biasControls.biasN > 1 ? d3.sum(biasX, d => (d - biasXbar) ** 2) / (biasControls.biasN - 1) : 0

// ========= Left panel: current sample ========= 
biasLeftBins = d3.bin().domain(biasXDomain).thresholds(biasControls.biasBins)(biasX)
biasLeftDensities = biasLeftBins.map(b => b.length / biasControls.biasN / Math.max(1e-9, b.x1 - b.x0))
biasLeftYMax = Math.max(0.1, d3.max(biasLeftDensities) || 0.1);

// ========= Shared computation =========
biasXPad = 3 * biasControls.biasTrueSigma
biasXDomain = [biasControls.biasTrueMu - biasXPad, biasControls.biasTrueMu + biasXPad]

biasLeftPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(600, Math.max(320, width/2 - 20)),
  height: 320,
  marginTop: 20,
  marginRight: 20,
  marginBottom: 40,
  marginLeft: 50,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 14,
  },
  x: { label: "Data", domain: biasXDomain },
  y: { label: "Density", domain: [0, biasLeftYMax * 1.1] },
  marks: [
    // histogram
    Plot.rectY(biasLeftBins, {
      x1: d => d.x0,
      x2: d => d.x1,
      y: d => d.length / biasControls.biasN / Math.max(1e-9, d.x1 - d.x0),
      fill: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      fillOpacity: 0.4
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    // ticks at data points
    Plot.ruleX(biasX, {
      y1: 0,
      y2: biasLeftYMax * 0.05,
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeOpacity: 0.8
    }),
  ]
});

// ========= Right panel: saved sample variances =========
variances = varianceHistory
trueVariance = biasControls.biasTrueSigma ** 2

// Calculate empirical bias
empiricalMean = variances.length > 0 ? d3.mean(variances) : null
empiricalBias = empiricalMean !== null ? empiricalMean - trueVariance : null

// Domain for right panel
varPad = trueVariance * 2
varDomain = variances.length > 0 
  ? [
      Math.min(d3.min(variances), 0),
      Math.max(d3.max(variances), trueVariance + varPad, sampleVar + 0.1)
    ]
  : [0, trueVariance + varPad]

// Compute histogram for variances if we have any
biasRightBins = variances.length > 0 
  ? d3.bin().domain(varDomain).thresholds(biasControls.biasBins)(variances)
  : [];
biasRightDensities = biasRightBins.map(b => 
  b.length / variances.length / Math.max(1e-9, b.x1 - b.x0)
);
biasRightYMax = Math.max(
  d3.max(biasRightDensities) || 0.1,
  0.1
);

// ------- usage inside your cell that creates the plot -------
biasRightPlot = {
  // Ensure d3 exists in this runtime
  const d3 = globalThis.d3 ?? await require("d3@7");

  const svg = Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(600, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 20)),
    height: 320,
    style: {
      background: "var(--plot-bg)",
      color: "var(--plot-fg)",
      fontFamily: bodyFont,
      fontSize: 14
    },
    x: { label: "naive variance (1/n)", domain: varDomain },
    y: { label: "Density", domain: [0, biasRightYMax * 1.1] },
    marks: [
      variances.length > 0 ? Plot.rectY(
        biasRightBins,
        {
          x1: d => d.x0,
          x2: d => d.x1,
          y: d => d.length / variances.length / (d.x1 - d.x0),
          fill: "var(--plot-series-4)",
          fillOpacity: 0.3
        }
      ) : null,
      variances.length > 0 ? Plot.ruleX(variances, {
        y1: 0,
        y2: biasRightYMax * 0.05,
        stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeOpacity: 0.8
      }) : null,
      Plot.ruleX([sampleVar], {
        y1: 0,
        y2: biasRightYMax * 0.07,
        stroke: "currentColor",
        strokeWidth: 3,
        strokeOpacity: 1
      }),
      Plot.ruleX([trueVariance], {
        stroke: "var(--plot-series-3)",
        strokeWidth: 3,
        strokeOpacity: biasControls.biasShowTrue ? 1 : 0
      }),
      empiricalMean !== null && biasControls.biasShowTrue ? Plot.ruleX([empiricalMean], {
        stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeDasharray: "6,3",
        strokeOpacity: 1
      }) : null,
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ].filter(Boolean)
  });

  // Legend items
  const items = [];
  if (biasControls.biasShowTrue) {
    items.push({ label: `σ² = ${trueVariance.toFixed(2)}`, stroke: "var(--plot-series-3)", strokeWidth: 3 });
  }
  if (empiricalMean !== null && biasControls.biasShowTrue) {
    items.push({ label: `E[naive variance] ≈ ${empiricalMean.toFixed(3)}`, stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)", strokeWidth: 2, dasharray: "6,3" });
  }

  if (items.length) addLegendTopRight(svg, items, { fontFamily: bodyFont, fontSize: 12, corner: 10 });

  return svg;
}


// ========= Display =========
{
  for (const f of [viewof biasResample, viewof biasReset]) {
    f.style.margin = "0";
    f.style.width = "100%";
    f.style.maxWidth = "none";
    f.style.display = "flex";
  }
  viewof biasResample.style.justifyContent = "flex-start";
  viewof biasReset.style.justifyContent = "flex-end";

  return html`<div class="ojs-toolbar-grid">
    <div class="left">${viewof biasResample}</div>
    <div class="center">
      ${empiricalBias !== null && biasControls.biasShowTrue ? html`
      <div>${tex`\widetilde s_n^2 = ${sampleVar.toFixed(3)} \,`}  and  ${tex`\, \text{Bias}(\widetilde S_n^2) \approx ${empiricalBias.toFixed(3)}`}</div>
      ` : html`<div>${tex`\widetilde s_n^2 = ${sampleVar.toFixed(3)}`}</div>`}
      <div style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.7">
        ${variances.length} sample${variances.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} collected
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="right">${viewof biasReset}</div>
  </div>

  <style>
    .ojs-toolbar-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;
      align-items:center;
      width:100%;
      box-sizing:border-box;
      margin:0; padding:0;
    }
    .ojs-toolbar-grid form{
      margin:0 !important;
      width:100% !important;
      max-width:none !important;
      display:flex !important;
    }
    .ojs-toolbar-grid .left form{ justify-content:flex-start !important; }
    .ojs-toolbar-grid .right form{ justify-content:flex-end !important; }

    .btn.btn-resample{ background: var(--brand-teal); color:#fff; border:none; }
    .btn.btn-resample:hover{ background: var(--brand-teal-hover); }
    .btn.btn-reset{ background: var(--brand-red); color:#fff; border:none; }
    .btn.btn-reset:hover{ background: var(--brand-red-hover); }
    .btn.btn-resample:focus-visible,
    .btn.btn-reset:focus-visible{
      outline: 2px solid currentColor;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .ojs-toolbar-grid .center{
      text-align:center;
      font-size:0.9rem;
      color: var(--brand-fg);
    }
  </style>`;
}

html`<div class="ojs-figure-shell">
  <div class="ojs-plot-grid">
    <div class="ojs-plot-panel">${biasLeftPlot}</div>
    <div class="ojs-plot-panel">${biasRightPlot}</div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
viewof biasControls = {
  const leftForm = Inputs.form({
    biasN: Inputs.range([2, 100], { value: 5, step: 1, label: md`${tex`n`}` }),
    biasTrueMu: Inputs.range([-2, 2], { value: 0, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\mu_{\text{true}}`}` }),
    biasTrueSigma: Inputs.range([0.3, 3], { value: 1, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\sigma_{\text{true}}`}` })
  }, { submit: false });

  const rightForm = Inputs.form({
    biasSamplesPerClick: Inputs.range([1, 10], { 
      value: 1, 
      step: 1, 
      label: "Samples per click" 
    }),
    biasBins: Inputs.range([10, 60], { value: 24, step: 1, label: "Histogram bins" }),
    biasShowTrue: Inputs.toggle({ label: md`Show empirical bias & true ${tex`\sigma^2`}`, value: true })
  }, { submit: false });
  
  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Simulation controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Data & truth size</h4></div>
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Display & actions</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  root.querySelector(".controls-grid").children[0].append(leftForm);
  root.querySelector(".controls-grid").children[1].append(rightForm);

  const getValue = () => ({ ...leftForm.value, ...rightForm.value });
  const update = () => {
    root.value = getValue();
    root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };

  leftForm.addEventListener("input", update);
  rightForm.addEventListener("input", update);

  queueMicrotask(update);
  return root;
}
```
